stages.name: Rig Canonicalization and PBR
stages.gate: armature + weighted mesh + canonical humanoid bones + 1.80-1.90m + valid scale + PBR slots

stages.name: Unreal Candidate Import
stages.gate: SkeletalMesh + reuse working Skeleton + PhysicsAsset + >=3 material slots + >=3 LODs
stages.replacement_policy: candidate-only; do not replace working HeroV3

stages.name: Unreal Technical QA
stages.gate: same working Skeleton + PhysicsAsset + >=3 material slots + >=3 LODs + >=2 compatible animation assets

stages.name: D3D12 Visual + Combat Evidence
stages.gate: scene prepared + fresh D3D12 screenshot + SHA256/bytes/git SHA/workflow run ID evidence + NARIS_COMBAT_QA_RESULT Pass=1 + fatal_count=0

stages.name: Hero Promotion + Package Regression
stages.gate: P0-04A PASS + P0-04B hash-bound render evidence + explicit APPROVED visual criteria + matching screenshot SHA256/bytes/candidate/baseline/qa_map/git SHA/workflow run ID + same Skeleton
stages.rollback: transactional asset rollback on any Win64 build, clean cook, package, packaged D3D12 combat QA, or log QA failure

local_execution.blocker: Remote Desktop Commander monthly usage limit reached; self-hosted workflow was not picked up by a Windows runner before cancellation.
local_execution.note: No claim is made that the new candidate has executed inside the AsusRog Unreal project.

current_working_hero.policy: retain until P0-05 full packaged regression passes

repository_verification.note: Static and repository contracts are green. This does not substitute for local Blender/Unreal execution.

external_candidate_execution.note: Corrected candidate v2 retained outside public repository; evidence committed separately. Unreal retarget/deformation/runtime QA remains required.
